Record the baselines of base's own tests that feature/area-geometry moves, on this run only

A branch rooted at upstream cannot hold them; the merge into base takes them.

The branches merged into feature/area-geometry last, the newest first:
* feature/line-geometry, with the dashes on Bezier curves by quarters
* feature/line-geometry, with the repetition of the glyphs along lines
* fix/dash-boundary-at-vertex, with OCAD's rule for the vertex next to the end of a dash
* fix/ocad-minimum-gaps, with the minimum gaps 2 and 3 of OCAD lines read as one
* fix/double-line-dash-gaps, with no minimum gap for the dashes of OCAD double lines
* fix/ocad-dash-count, with the dash count of OCAD lines as OCAD counts it
* fix/ocad-metric-parameter, with the metric of OCAD 6 to 10 files as the current OCAD reads it
* fix/thick-glyph-circles, with OCAD's filled glyph circles
* feature/symbol-geometry, with the geometry method of point symbols in pass 1
* feature/map-instances, with the coverage of dashed lines whose gaps are shorter than a pixel
